summary:
Chartered Accountant with ~6 years of post-qualification experience in Audit – assurance.
Working with EY GDS as Assistant Manager.

bullets: Involved in statutory and tax audits of various entities where work included – Verification, ledger scrutiny and audit finalization.
Preparation of Tax Audit Reports, Income tax computations and filing of Income Tax Returns.
Lead and managed both Listed and Private clients in the finalization and closure of their books of accounts.
Conducted internal audits for a variety of entities across different sectors.
Articleship:

jobs.company: Ernst & Young Global Delivery Services India LLP
bullets: Supervised and managed a team of ~6-8 resources of semi-qualified Chartered Accountants and staff accountants.
Conducted statutory audits for clients based in the U.S., regularly interacting with both the EY US team and client representatives.
Performed substantive analytical procedures on key audit areas such as revenue, payroll, and expenses.
Executed statutory audits across multiple industries, including food and beverage, aviation, and automotive.
Carried out test of details on various audit sections including Cash, Revenue, Property, Plant & Equipment (PPE), Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Accruals, Debt, and Expenses.
Prepared the Summary of Audit Differences for identified misstatements and drafted the Management Representation Letter.
Utilized data analytics tools (e.g., General Ledger Analyzer) to perform Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and Journal Entry Testing.
Prepared lead sheets for various accounts and conducted variance analysis in comparison to prior year figures.
Participated in analytical reviews and the financial statement review and tie-out process.
Proficient in digital audit tools such as EY Helix, EY Canvas, EY Random, EY Microstart, and Data Snipper.
Built and maintained strong working relationships with clients and the EY US team, proactively coordinating to obtain required information.
Finalization of Financial Statements of Individual, Firms & Companies.
Preparation and e-filling of ITR.
Calculation of Advance Tax, MAT.
Tax Audits under section 44AB of Income Tax Act 1961.
